name: Struq
tagline: Cinematic, award-winning web design for coding agents
description: Struq picks a design direction from a short brief and hands Cline an ordered build plan for an Awwwards-level marketing site: a curated palette, a typography pairing, the project shell, a GSAP and Lenis motion system, and a spec for every section. Also audits React and Tailwind projects without reading their source. OAuth sign-in; free accounts get direction advice and the audit, Pro unlocks the full build line and the design library.
